title: Battle event (the event database row)
description: One event mention, with its time, type, actors and the exact words of the source. An EVENT is the merge of the mentions that tell the same thing (event_id on the mention rows; merge is a separate, reviewed step). Pilot: events/pilot-100.jsonl (mentions, one reviewer). Production adds: merged event ids, location polygon, the unit-state rows the event must be consistent with, and the contested register.

minute_of_day.description: null when the o'clock has no a.m./p.m. in the sentence and the corpus did not resolve it (14 of 87 timed pilot mentions): such mentions need the day-context step

time.description: the clock as the witness wrote it; never converted. The event minute inherits the uncertainty of docs/time (25 minutes at best).

type.description: move, order, fire_open, fire_cease, attack, repulse, casualty_killed, casualty_wounded, capture (extraction types); reviewed types add command_change, rally, withdrawal, engagement_end, ground_gained, accident, intelligence_hearsay, ...

text.description: the sentence, verbatim from the corpus (public-domain Official Records)

event_id.description: production: id of the merged event
